name: general-service-impl
description: The general-service@1 provider `config-dispatch`: ONE service whose config TYPE (local | container | ssh | ssh+container | http) selects the transport service at call time. No hard injection of the transports: only the type's service must be loaded, an unknown or missing one fails loudly before any command runs.

loadAfterTimeoutMs.description: Bound of the SOFT, non-required wait for the transport services before this plugin provides its own (ordering hint, never a dependency)
